description: This file defines a final utility class 'EntityTypes' that provides factory methods for creating instances of 'DefaultEntityType' based on input strings. It includes annotations indicating thread safety and is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.entity.type' package, serving as an internal helper for entity type management within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: EntityTypes
classes.description: A factory class providing methods to obtain instances of 'DefaultEntityType' based on input character sequences. It is immutable and cannot be instantiated.

methods.name: getDefaultEntityType
methods.description: Returns a 'DefaultEntityType' instance for the provided CharSequence value by delegating to the 'DefaultEntityType.of' method.
